publisher: UK Visas and Immigration (Home Office), GOV.UK
raw_extract:
## Fees

It costs:

-   £558 to apply for a Student visa from outside the UK
-   £558 to extend or switch to a Student visa from inside the UK

You must pay the visa fee for each person that joins you.

### Healthcare surcharge

You’ll also have to [pay the healthcare surcharge](/healthcare-immigration-application) as part of your application.

How much you pay depends on how long your visa lasts.
research_notes: Application fee taken verbatim from the 'Fees' section of the Student visa overview page (note: the URL /student-visa/how-much-it-costs redirected to this overview, so this overview page is the authoritative location for the figure). The Immigration Health Surcharge is a separate charge and is published on a separate gov.uk page, recorded in 003b_visa_fees_ihs.json. The IHS is a per-year cost, not a flat fee, so it must not be added as a single figure to a budget.

claims.statement: A Student visa application made from outside the UK costs £558.
Extending or switching to a Student visa from inside the UK also costs £558, and the fee is payable per person for each dependant.
